description:
One thing a source says about one of its units, quoted word for word and checked by code.

``kind`` comes from the closed list a topic supplies; ``fsi_common`` holds no list of its own.
The id is derived from the kind, the subject, the quote and the attributes, so a rerun that
finds the same thing gives the same id whatever produced it.

attributes.description: The fact's normalised attributes, for example a requirement and a deadline as written

checks.description: The plain-code checks run on the fact
checks.title: Checks

kind.description: The kind of fact, from the topic's closed list
kind.title: Kind

quote.description: Text copied word for word from the subject unit
quote.title: Quote

subject.description: The source unit the fact is about

title: Fact
